package seglog

// This program wrote testdata/v0_log.tar.gz and testdata/v0_log.json: a log
// written by seglog as it was before raft moved to
// google.golang.org/protobuf (raftseg 3bfbd2c, raft a954a6c, whose raftpb
// was gogo's generated code), and what that seglog read back from it. It
// ran as a test in a checkout of that commit:
//
//	SEGLOG_GEN_V0=/tmp/out go test ./seglog -run TestGenerateV0Log
//
// TestReadsV0Log checks that seglog reads such a log as that version did.

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"io/fs"
	"math"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/raftseg/raft/raftpb"
)

type v0Entry struct {
	Index, Term uint64
	Type        int32
	Size        int    // of the encoding, as Entries returned the entry
	Sum         string // SHA-256 of the encoding
}

type v0Group struct {
	ID        uint64
	HardState []byte // encoding, as InitialState returned it
	ConfState []byte
	First     uint64
	Last      uint64
	Entries   []v0Entry
	Snapshot  struct {
		Metadata []byte // encoding
		DataSum  string // SHA-256
	}
}

type v0Log struct {
	Comment string
	Groups  []v0Group
	Removed []uint64
}

func TestGenerateV0Log(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("SEGLOG_GEN_V0")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("set SEGLOG_GEN_V0")
	}
	dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "log")
	opts := Options{SegmentSize: 64 << 10, SnapshotInlineBytes: 512, CacheEntries: 16, NoPreallocate: true}
	l, err := Open(dir, opts)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(1))
	// Data repeats a random 61-byte pattern, so that the archive
	// compresses.
	data := func(n int) []byte {
		p := make([]byte, 61)
		r.Read(p)
		return bytes.Repeat(p, n/61+1)[:n]
	}
	must := func(err error) {
		t.Helper()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	ents := func(lo, hi, term uint64) []raftpb.Entry {
		var es []raftpb.Entry
		for i := lo; i <= hi; i++ {
			e := raftpb.Entry{Term: term, Index: i, Type: raftpb.EntryNormal}
			switch {
			case i == 1:
				cc := raftpb.ConfChangeV2{Transition: raftpb.ConfChangeTransitionJointExplicit, Changes: []raftpb.ConfChangeSingle{
					{Type: raftpb.ConfChangeAddNode, NodeID: 1}, {Type: raftpb.ConfChangeAddNode, NodeID: 2}, {Type: raftpb.ConfChangeAddNode, NodeID: 3}},
					Context: []byte("ctx")}
				e.Type, e.Data = raftpb.EntryConfChangeV2, mustMarshal(t, &cc)
			case i == 10:
				cc := raftpb.ConfChange{ID: 7, Type: raftpb.ConfChangeAddLearnerNode, NodeID: 4}
				e.Type, e.Data = raftpb.EntryConfChange, mustMarshal(t, &cc)
			case i%17 == 0:
				e.Data = data(33000) // spans blocks and chunks
			case i%5 == 0:
				// no data: an empty entry, as a new leader appends
			default:
				e.Data = data(r.Intn(1500))
			}
			es = append(es, e)
		}
		return es
	}

	g1 := l.Group(1)
	must(g1.Save(raftpb.HardState{Term: 1, Vote: 1}, ents(1, 50, 1), raftpb.Snapshot{}))
	must(g1.Save(raftpb.HardState{Term: 2, Vote: 2, Commit: 40}, ents(45, 80, 2), raftpb.Snapshot{})) // overwrites 45..50
	cs := raftpb.ConfState{Voters: []uint64{1, 2, 3}, Learners: []uint64{4}}
	_, err = g1.CreateSnapshot(30, &cs, data(5000)) // in a file
	must(err)
	must(g1.Compact(30))
	must(g1.Save(raftpb.HardState{Term: 3, Vote: 3, Commit: 80}, ents(81, 120, 3), raftpb.Snapshot{}))
	must(g1.SetConfState(raftpb.ConfState{Voters: []uint64{1, 2, 3}, Learners: []uint64{4}, VotersOutgoing: []uint64{1, 2}, LearnersNext: []uint64{5}, AutoLeave: true}))

	g2 := l.Group(2)
	snap := raftpb.Snapshot{Data: data(100), Metadata: raftpb.SnapshotMetadata{Index: 100, Term: 4, ConfState: raftpb.ConfState{Voters: []uint64{1, 2}}}}
	must(g2.Save(raftpb.HardState{Term: 5, Vote: 2, Commit: 100}, nil, snap)) // inline
	must(g2.Save(raftpb.HardState{Term: 5, Vote: 2, Commit: 105}, ents(101, 110, 5), raftpb.Snapshot{}))

	g7 := l.Group(7)
	must(g7.Save(raftpb.HardState{Term: 1, Vote: 7, Commit: 2}, ents(1, 20, 1), raftpb.Snapshot{}))
	must(l.RemoveGroup(7))

	g9 := l.Group(9)
	must(g9.Save(raftpb.HardState{Term: 6, Vote: 9}, nil, raftpb.Snapshot{}))

	// Several updates in one group commit.
	must(l.Save(
		Update{Group: 1, HardState: raftpb.HardState{Term: 3, Vote: 3, Commit: 120}, Entries: ents(121, 125, 3)},
		Update{Group: 2, HardState: raftpb.HardState{Term: 6, Vote: 1, Commit: 110}, Entries: ents(111, 112, 6)},
	))
	must(l.Close())

	// What this version reads back, after a restart.
	l, err = Open(dir, opts)
	must(err)
	res := v0Log{Comment: "Written by seglog at raftseg 3bfbd2c (raft a954a6c, gogo raftpb) with SegmentSize 64 KiB, SnapshotInlineBytes 512; see genv0log.go.txt.", Removed: []uint64{7}}
	for _, id := range l.Groups() {
		s := l.Group(id)
		var g v0Group
		g.ID = id
		hs, cs, err := s.InitialState()
		must(err)
		g.HardState, g.ConfState = mustMarshal(t, &hs), mustMarshal(t, &cs)
		g.First, err = s.FirstIndex()
		must(err)
		g.Last, err = s.LastIndex()
		must(err)
		if g.Last >= g.First {
			es, err := s.Entries(g.First, g.Last+1, math.MaxUint64)
			must(err)
			for i := range es {
				b := mustMarshal(t, &es[i])
				g.Entries = append(g.Entries, v0Entry{Index: es[i].Index, Term: es[i].Term, Type: int32(es[i].Type), Size: len(b), Sum: sum(b)})
			}
		}
		sn, err := s.Snapshot()
		must(err)
		g.Snapshot.Metadata, g.Snapshot.DataSum = mustMarshal(t, &sn.Metadata), sum(sn.Data)
		res.Groups = append(res.Groups, g)
	}
	must(l.Close())

	js, err := json.MarshalIndent(res, "", " ")
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "v0_log.json"), append(js, '\n'), 0o644))
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "v0_log.tar.gz"), tarDir(t, dir), 0o644))
}

func sum(b []byte) string {
	s := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return hex.EncodeToString(s[:])
}

func mustMarshal(t *testing.T, m interface{ Marshal() ([]byte, error) }) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := m.Marshal()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b
}

// tarDir archives the files of dir, in name order, with fixed metadata.
func tarDir(t *testing.T, dir string) []byte {
	var names []string
	err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err == nil && d.Type().IsRegular() {
			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(dir, p)
			names = append(names, filepath.ToSlash(rel))
		}
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	zw, _ := gzip.NewWriterLevel(&buf, gzip.BestCompression)
	tw := tar.NewWriter(zw)
	for _, n := range names {
		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, filepath.FromSlash(n)))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := tw.WriteHeader(&tar.Header{Name: n, Mode: 0o644, Size: int64(len(b)), Typeflag: tar.TypeReg, Format: tar.FormatPAX}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := tw.Write(b); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err := tw.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := zw.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return buf.Bytes()
}
